answer: The owner keeps a list of beneficiaries that can be changed at any time with a signed update, and only the latest list is valid at handover. A removed beneficiary loses all claim rights immediately. A Sybil attacker cannot lock in a fake beneficiary, since the owner can revoke the entry before the handover fires. The record keeps every karst visible, so anyone can audit the handover. The oasis test catches the lazy fake and the haven test catches the patient one.
